---
title: "Publications"
---

Only published articles and reports are available for download.

```{r}
library(reactable)
p <- read.csv("data/publications.csv")
reactable(
  p, searchable = TRUE, filterable = TRUE,
  columns = list(
    doi = colDef(cell = function(v) htmltools::tags$a(href = paste0("https://doi.org/", v), target = "_blank", v)),
    pdf = colDef(name = "Download", filterable = FALSE,
                 cell = function(v) if (nzchar(v)) htmltools::tags$a(href = v, "PDF") else "")
  )
)
```

Put PDFs in `files/` and reference them as `files/name.pdf` in `data/publications.csv`.
